{{Quote|She's not one of the fancier vessels that are currently on my lot, but she is beyond your standard stock freighter and would serve most any run with high competency.|Fiz Cor'gril trying to sell the ship|<ref name="AJ9" />}}
The '''''Rogue Runner''''' was a [[Gymsnor-3 light freighter/Legends|Gymsnor-3 light freighter]] that was part of the stock of [[Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The previous owner had modified the ship by adding weapons and shields however the [[Ion engine/Legends|Ion drive]] was old and needed to be replaced.

==Description==
''Rogue Runner'' was a modified [[Gymsnor-3 light freighter/Legends|Gymsnor-3]] that was 34.1 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length. It boasted an old [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]] capable of reaching speeds of 800 [[Kilometer per hour/Legends|km/h]] in atmosphere. Its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] had also been upgraded to a Class 1.0 speed. The backup hyperdrive remained the stock Class 15.0. It had been upgraded to support a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] and was protected by a single turreted heavy [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]]. It only required a single crewmember to fly and could carry up to four passengers and had consumables good for a single [[Standard month/Legends|month]]. Its cargo bays were slightly smaller then a stock ship due to the added weapons and shield at only 75 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]]. It came equipped with [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]], lifesupport, and a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]].<ref name="AJ9" />

Close inspection of the ship revealed that its hull had undergone a lot of stress in the past and that the ion drive was worn and needed to be replaced. When pushed to the limit the engines would blow out and require repairs before the ship could continue to move.<ref name="AJ9" />

==History==
While its prior ownership is unknown, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] it was for sale by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Fiz Cor'gril]] at his shop on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trevi IV]]. He had it for sale for 35,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. A used salesmen through and through, Cor'gril would neglect to mention that the ion engines were on the verge of complete failure.<ref name="AJ9" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Rogue Runner'' was designed by [[John J. Richardson III]] for the article [[Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships (article)|''Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships'']] that was published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 9]] in February [[1996]]. It was published as a supplement to [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]] created by [[West End Games]].
